title: Chapter 332 Dojo Expansion
content:
Chapter 332 Dojo Expansion

Time flies, in the blink of an eye, two years have passed since Zhong Yu came to this world.

In the past two years, Zhong Yu's influence on this world has not been as great as imagined.

In other words, it did not have any earth-shaking or impact on the power structure of this world. It doesn't even have any obvious impact on the pattern of an area.

However, although the influence is very small, Zhong Yu has completed his most critical step towards conquering the world in the past two years.

In the past two years, the prestige of Zhong Yu's Lingtian Dojo has become more and more prominent.

The power of the dojo is expanding more and more, it has broken through the shackles of the surrounding counties and villages in Yamamoto County, and has completely moved towards the entire Dewa country.

And after several martial arts competitions, the new disciples of the dojo continued to beat other dojo heirs, which made the name of the dojo's wonderful techniques spread throughout the Deyu country.

Zhong Yu then took advantage of the trend to expand, completely annexed or expelled other dojos in Deyu country, and occupied the share of the entire Deyu country dojo.

And the disciples who walked out of the dojo continued to join the tyrants, daimyos, and even the lord of the Dewa country.

In their respective forces, they have mastered important military power, and even local security. It can be said that the field controls the entire Deyu country faintly.

However, all the forces in Dewa Country were not aware of this invisible control.

Instead, they fell into the joy of having a lot of talents under their command, and their strength had expanded several times. They didn't want anything else.

It took Zhong Yu a whole year to control the entire Deyu country.

Afterwards, the resources of the Dewa country were integrated, and the sphere of influence of the dojo expanded to the Echigo and Mutsu countries next to the Dewa country.

The local tyrants of the two countries are powerful, and various dojos emerge in endlessly, far surpassing the backward Deyu country.

It can be said that the strength of the local dojos of the two countries is more than two or three times that of the Dewa country, and it is not the same as the barbarian caps of the Dewa country.

Therefore, when expanding to these two countries, there were fierce conflicts with those local dojos.

This is a matter of interests and the survival of their respective dojos, so it can be said that the two sides fight without holding back, and it is a completely deadly fight.

Because of the expansion of Ling Tian Dao Temple, the wars between the two countries have become more frequent, and the local tyrants supported by their respective Dao Temples continued to attack each other, causing a chaotic situation to sweep across the two countries.

However, Ling Tian Dojo has a great advantage after all.

First of all, the dojo has consolidated the resources of the entire Dewa country, and has a complete rear and foundation, unlike the dojos of other two countries that are scattered, and now they only form a loose alliance to resist the invasion of the dojo.

What's more, although the dojos in the Dewa country are weak, the overall population of the Dewa country is not inferior to other places.

Especially the Echigo country, its population is almost the same as that of the Dewa country, and its overall strength is not much different.

The reason why the Chuyu country was not as good as these countries before was that there was no strong leader, which led to the weakness of the overall power.

However, now that Zhong Yu has appeared, the Lingtian Dojo he created has integrated the entire Chuyu Kingdom and fully stimulated his potential.

And the exercises he taught on the spot are a kind of quick success method that is close to the magic path. Unlike other dojos, it takes more than ten years or even longer to practice successfully.

While it took so long for these dojos to achieve the effect, Zhong Yu only needed half a year, or a year.

Therefore, the strength of Zhong Yu's dojo grew bigger and bigger as the war progressed, and gradually swept into a general trend, crushing all the dojos that blocked his expansion.

After a year, the dojos in the two countries have been retreating steadily. Whether it is the magic of fighting or the improvement of strength, they are all inferior to Lingtian dojo.

So this kind of ending is not difficult to predict.

For these dojos, the defeat on the frontal battlefield is not serious. What is really serious is their foundation, that is, the local tyrants who supported them, and they abandoned them.

The reason why those local tyrants need dojos is because the dojos can provide them with powerful warriors and make their families stronger.

But now, a behemoth that more suits their appetite and form appears, Lingtian Dojo.

Cultivate talents faster, have more sophisticated fighting skills, and kill faster. No matter how you look at it, the Lingtian Dojo with these advantages is more in line with the development situation of the Warring States Period than other dojos.

In today's Warring States period, there are wars happening all the time.

These tyrants don't know when they will be destroyed, and they don't know when war will happen.

Therefore, they all strengthened their armaments, and constantly waited for opportunities to annex people who were weaker than themselves, so as to strengthen their own strength and ensure that their chances of being destroyed were reduced.

Annexation will lead to wars, and in these frequent wars, the number of warriors of each family is constantly decreasing, and often a war consumes too much, and it will take several years for each family to recover.

And for so many years, who can guarantee that there will be no accidents, if a stronger person attacks him during the period, and his strength is abnormally weak, then the destruction of the family will be inevitable.

Therefore, they can quickly provide them with many warriors, and these warriors are more powerful.

It is far beyond what other ashrams can provide to those tyrannical things.

With such powerful names, what reason do they have to support those local ashrams that are more expensive but less effective.

Therefore, after the war has been going on for a period of time, these powerful names clearly discovered the gap between the two.

In the spirit of pragmatism, they quickly abandoned those local dojos and withdrew their assistance. It made the situation in the local dojo even worse, and after the loss, it was impossible to rush to the backup.

After all, if the local tyrant supports the local dojo, but suddenly there is a tyrant next to him who accepts the Lingtian dojo, then his strength will skyrocket.

If he suddenly sent troops to wipe out this powerful man who was still standing still, then he would have no time to cry.

Therefore, with the gradual abandonment of the local tyrants of the two countries, the sphere of influence of these local dojos has been shrinking.

These local ashrams were either expelled or eliminated.

Or it could simply be swallowed up by the Lingtian Dojo as a whole, and integrated into the Lingtian Dojo system.

Then these dojos accepted some skills from Lingtian Dojo, and after increasing their strength, they annexed the remaining local dojos in turn.

This gradually formed a virtuous circle, making the scale of Lingtian Dojo like a snowball, getting bigger and bigger, gradually sweeping the two countries.

In a year's time, the local ashrams of the two countries have shrunk to some extremely remote corners, lingering on their last legs, and it seems that they will not last long.
